svg.title: FlashDeconv workflow
svg.desc: FlashDeconv framework aligned with the revised Methods: reference-derived leverage scores yield deterministic expected CountSketch amplitude weights. Log-normalized selected profiles are scaled gene-wise without projection. A symmetric spatial graph and Gram-scaled penalties enter nonnegative regression with precomputed Gram and cross-product matrices. Row normalization yields proportions; an optional reference diagnostic reports unexplained genes and candidate missing types. All maps are schematic.
